scope: Same Tsuchiura preserved Otsu: 2007 appearance, 2025 geometry corroboration and same-car walkaround; early Ko and different museum variants remain excluded

requirements.observedGap: Flat half-disc lids lack the photographed turned skirt, dish and oval opening
requirements.action: Turned skirts, shallow dishes, oval hand openings and outreach bearings compared in closed2025 and open2007 states; raised cupola riser remains visible above the shorter shell. The160/175degree comparison pose is independent of rest geometry.
requirements.reviewResult: Turned skirts, shallow dishes, oval hand openings and outreach bearings compared in closed2025 and open2007 states; raised cupola riser remains visible above the shorter shell. The160/175degree comparison pose is independent of rest geometry.
requirements.limits: Small game rim facets and atlas-edge precision remain a game-LOD approximation; the retained high source supplies the continuous authoring surface.

requirements.observedGap: Both pressed profiles faced +X; main left view showed a flat back
requirements.action: Both banks now expose the correctly oriented pressed face, with the curved recessed dish, hub shoulder and fasteners. Primary2007/left-front17/18 and opposite20 views checked.
requirements.reviewResult: Both banks now expose the correctly oriented pressed face, with the curved recessed dish, hub shoulder and fasteners. Primary2007/left-front17/18 and opposite20 views checked.
requirements.limits: Contact-band composition remains a material inference; no claim of a measured factory cross-section.

requirements.observedGap: Plain discs and generic box teeth omit the visible cast rim and ribs
requirements.action: Scalloped outer flanges, eight cast ribs and distinct recessed wheel faces checked against the primary idler and19/31 drive close-ups. Dark cast recesses were not invented as unsupported through-openings.
requirements.reviewResult: Scalloped outer flanges, eight cast ribs and distinct recessed wheel faces checked against the primary idler and19/31 drive close-ups. Dark cast recesses were not invented as unsupported through-openings.
requirements.limits: Concealed casting sections remain reconstructed; game small relief uses the retained-high projection.

requirements.observedGap: Cylinder and plate omit clamp rails, hex heads, end collar and lock detail
requirements.action: Axle-height grease cylinder, two clamp rails, collars, hex hardware, lock detail and pressed housing reinforcement now follow the original close-ups; front housing outline checked in the primary and both front quarters.
requirements.reviewResult: Axle-height grease cylinder, two clamp rails, collars, hex hardware, lock detail and pressed housing reinforcement now follow the original close-ups; front housing outline checked in the primary and both front quarters.
requirements.limits: Small concealed clamp backs and dimensions are photograph-proportioned reconstruction.

requirements.observedGap: Exposed generic wheel hub misses the fixed bearing shield and large hex nut
requirements.action: Fixed bearing shield has the smaller rounded end, correct relation to the rotating wheel, raised boss and large hex nut;19/24/31 views checked.
requirements.reviewResult: Fixed bearing shield has the smaller rounded end, correct relation to the rotating wheel, raised boss and large hex nut;19/24/31 views checked.
requirements.limits: The visible casting and shield are matched; hidden axle mechanics are simplified.

requirements.observedGap: Squared driver flap and simple lever miss rounded cover, loop and port lip; latch did not move with door
requirements.action: Original2007 inspection resolved the cylindrical perforated MG jacket, flanged lower mounting foot with nine hex bolts, and round port opened180degrees with an inner five-point badge. Driver visor/half-round shutter, door-mounted D-loop, transverse tow bores and staggered lower bow rivets checked against16/20.
requirements.reviewResult: Original2007 inspection resolved the cylindrical perforated MG jacket, flanged lower mounting foot with nine hex bolts, and round port opened180degrees with an inner five-point badge. Driver visor/half-round shutter, door-mounted D-loop, transverse tow bores and staggered lower bow rivets checked against16/20.
requirements.limits: The pointed removable2025 MG cover is a different accessory state, excluded from the chosen2007 appearance. Hidden vent rows and hinge backs are reconstructed, and badge finish is not original1938 paint evidence.

requirements.observedGap: Wire grid is not the perforated sheet with small rounded holes, broad bands and ends
requirements.action: Three panels/51columns over0.88m, broad bands, ends and lower shelf position checked against2/19/24/34. Actual high holes and1.6mm sheet thickness correspond to the game UV0 MASK pattern; near/far game and high views checked.
requirements.reviewResult: Three panels/51columns over0.88m, broad bands, ends and lower shelf position checked against2/19/24/34. Actual high holes and1.6mm sheet thickness correspond to the game UV0 MASK pattern; near/far game and high views checked.
requirements.limits: Exact invisible hole burrs and surface micro-wear remain authoring detail.

requirements.observedGap: Overall tapered shell, side planform, plate junctions and individual rivet groups have not been verified against every view
requirements.action: Shorter0.500m tapered body, flat front, extended rear planform, raised cupola riser, paired six-station seam groups and wider lower attachment groups checked across the primary, frontal, both quarters and side originals.
requirements.reviewResult: Shorter0.500m tapered body, flat front, extended rear planform, raised cupola riser, paired six-station seam groups and wider lower attachment groups checked across the primary, frontal, both quarters and side originals.
requirements.limits: Photographic camera/crop recovery is incomplete; manual17/18 views and planar20 fit are inspection aids, not a dimensional or pixel-RMS certification. Concealed rivet groups remain inferred.

requirements.observedGap: Sight aperture, yoke edges, barrel collars/recoil hardware and mounting bolts need individual comparison
requirements.action: Native16/20 comparison confirms the open inner C-notch, separate vertical backing slit, flat D-section lower front, twin thin rods/retainers, seated collar, mixed hex/round frame heads and exposed57mm flat metal muzzle annulus. Actual close-up and deep-bore checks show no false liner stripes.
requirements.reviewResult: Native16/20 comparison confirms the open inner C-notch, separate vertical backing slit, flat D-section lower front, twin thin rods/retainers, seated collar, mixed hex/round frame heads and exposed57mm flat metal muzzle annulus. Actual close-up and deep-bore checks show no false liner stripes.
requirements.limits: Barrel interior is a simple recessed dark cavity, not a claim about hidden rifling or engineering liners.

requirements.observedGap: Fold line, panel joins, hinge stations and rolled lip must be individually matched
requirements.action: Three middle and three fold hinges per cover, upright paired seam rivets, three-panel joins, pressed front contours and rolled shelf checked against the primary and17/18/19/20/31. Rounded rear tip now continues beyond the belt toY-2.825/Z1.150 and rolls down rather than ending over the wheel.
requirements.reviewResult: Three middle and three fold hinges per cover, upright paired seam rivets, three-panel joins, pressed front contours and rolled shelf checked against the primary and17/18/19/20/31. Rounded rear tip now continues beyond the belt toY-2.825/Z1.150 and rolls down rather than ending over the wheel.
requirements.limits: Sheet thickness and hidden support backs are reconstructed; directional-light track shadows are illumination, not stains baked into Base.

requirements.observedGap: Window curvature, pin-knuckle structure and edge cast relief need per-shoe comparison
requirements.action: Four real windows, shorter angled outer windows, three leading flange keyways, central trailing relief, three pin barrels and high-source pin-eye bores compared against native16/20 and32. False solid end buttons removed. Falling return rollers and sagged upper run checked against primary/19.
requirements.reviewResult: Four real windows, shorter angled outer windows, three leading flange keyways, central trailing relief, three pin barrels and high-source pin-eye bores compared against native16/20 and32. False solid end buttons removed. Falling return rollers and sagged upper run checked against primary/19.
requirements.limits: Small pin-eye bores use high geometry and game normal/AO projection; the game retains true geometry for all four large windows. Fine casting damage is not a photo-by-photo scan.

requirements.observedGap: Deck panel shapes, louvre locations, rear lamp and tail joints have not all been proven in each rear reference
requirements.action: Falling engine deck, visible panel/louvre placement, separate hatch handles, shorter guard, rear-facing glazed lamp and curved channel tail with flat ties/riveted gussets checked against2/18/19/24/34.
requirements.reviewResult: Falling engine deck, visible panel/louvre placement, separate hatch handles, shorter guard, rear-facing glazed lamp and curved channel tail with flat ties/riveted gussets checked against2/18/19/24/34.
requirements.limits: Photographs do not resolve every upper vent or concealed joint; those details remain explicitly reconstructed. The preview lighting is not a recovered original HDRI.

acceptance: Each visible component must be checked in its relevant photos and actual game/high exports; unresolved rows prevent completion. Whole-envelope dimensions, a small camera landmark residual or a passing PBR channel test cannot stand in for this review.
progressNote: All12 components compared against their relevant native photographs and actual V26 game/high views. Numeric gates and camera residuals were not substituted for the visual review.
